title: Up Next
description: A now-playing view with its queue: drag a song by its grip and the others part around it while the list scrolls itself at the edges, swipe a row left and it folds into a red Remove action with an undo in the header, and tap any song to fly its cover into the player.
intent: Reorder, remove and play as direct gestures on one list: every move is retargetable mid-flight, rows never leave their card, and the undo lives where it cannot cover the queue.
